title: SEC filing: quantum computing startup Quantinuum boosts its IPO, aiming to sell 26.5M shares for $53-$55 each, raising up to $1.46B at an up to $14.3B valuation (Liana Baker/Bloomberg)
summary: Liana Baker / Bloomberg: SEC filing: quantum computing startup Quantinuum boosts its IPO, aiming to sell 26.5M shares for $53-$55 each, raising up to $1.46B at an up to $14.3B valuation — Honeywell International Inc.-backed quantum computing company Quantinuum Inc. boosted the size of its initial public offering …
